body: Experimental feature behind `experimental.richChatContent` (off by default): make what agents send back rich in native chat, like Claude's own apps. ## Scope 1. **Inline images** from all three harnesses: - Codex `imageGeneration` (`savedPath` / base64 `result`) and `imageView` - ACP `image` content blocks (already mapped in `acp-chat-mapper.ts:75`) - Claude tool-result `ImageBlockParam` (e.g. Read on a PNG, MCP screenshots) Shown as a lazy thumbnail with click-to-open in a lightbox. 2. **File chips**: file paths in agent text and tool output become chips with a preview popover: Monaco for text/code, an image viewer, `
title: [MEDIUM] Epic: rich chat content (inline images, file chips, link and PR tokens), experimental
